command: pre-registration: PLAN_PARTS round 13, role-level transport (docs/PARTS_RESULTS.md section 41)

metrics.arm: P_rtr: P_imd's flags without --rclip, plus --rtransport; object term retrained, target term reused from <cond>_tdc; seeds 10-12; builds full, nobottle, noplate and the S3 creations
metrics.familiar_nonregression: pooled familiar known-pairing success K1-K6, P_rtr - P_imd, same bootstrap; 'regresses' iff the CI upper bound < 0 (reported, no verdict)
metrics.layer2_go: pp_l2's mapping, unchanged (S1 as restated; S2 3F + OM in both layouts; S3 ratio >= 0.8, LB >= 0.6, both atoms, both layouts, k in {1, 5, 10})
metrics.metric: bottle_hold_new: new-layout hold pooled over K4, K5, N4, N5, N6, seeds pooled; P_rtr - P_imd, 2,000-draw state bootstrap
metrics.reported_no_verdict: r_s per part and r_role per build; share of pre-hold calls served by the backbone alone (pp_far_diag, seed 10)
metrics.round_verdict: improves iff delta > 0.10 and the CI lower bound > 0
metrics.s1_restated: S1 holds iff, with every target part's m fixed to v for each v in the inventory, both swap tests and every target-into-grasp component are exactly 0 for every seed
metrics.states: dev: N2 main states 4-23, N2 seeds
metrics.written_before: the round's S1 read and any of its rollouts
